title: ShareVault deposit inflates the share price for later depositors

root_cause.description: The first depositor sets the share price with a single wei, so all later depositors buy shares at a price the attacker chose, diluting their position.
root_cause.mechanism: deposit() mints shares at total_assets/total_shares before any real assets are in the vault

invariant.statement: a depositor's share of total assets may not decrease as a result of their own deposit

assumptions.claim: the vault can be empty when the first deposit arrives

exploit_sequence.action: deposit(1 wei) to set the share price
deposit(1 ETH) at the attacker-set price
